allow: PowerShell($flutter = \(Get-Command flutter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Source; if \($flutter\) { Write-Host "flutter: $flutter"; $flutterDir = Split-Path $flutter; $dartCandidates = @\("$flutterDir\\dart.bat", "$flutterDir\\dart", "$flutterDir\\cache\\dart-sdk\\bin\\dart.exe"\); foreach \($d in $dartCandidates\) { if \(Test-Path $d\) { Write-Host "dart found: $d" } } } else { Write-Host "flutter NOT in PATH" })

PowerShell($paths = @\("C:\\flutter", "C:\\src\\flutter", "C:\\tools\\flutter", "C:\\dev\\flutter", "$env:USERPROFILE\\flutter", "$env:USERPROFILE\\fvm\\default", "C:\\flutter-projects\\flutter"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { $dart = "$p\\bin\\dart.bat"; if \(Test-Path $dart\) { Write-Host "FOUND: $dart" } }; Write-Host "--- env FLUTTER_ROOT ---"; $env:FLUTTER_ROOT; Write-Host "--- pubspec dart sdk hint ---")
